title: Atlantis search presentation to Victor Vescovo

tellings.quote: But Victor Victor is interested. We gave him the presentation on Atlantis and he said, "All right, I'm in."

plain: A retired Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet says that in the 2020s he and others gave a presentation on searching the ocean for Atlantis, the legendary lost island city, to an explorer named Victor Vescovo. Gallaudet says Vescovo was interested and answered, "All right, I'm in." He tells it as someone who was in the room, and if true it would mean a serious search for Atlantis has a backer.
